This unofficial guide to Stardew Valley, strives to improve your gaming experience through a simple, intuitive interface that allows you to quickly find the info you need, so you can focus on the most important thing: Playing Stardew Valley! 


BROWSE AND YOU WILL FIND
This app’s content is based on the Stardew Valley Wiki and centers around the core of your gameplay. Through a simple and intuitive interface, the app makes it easy to access information that you continuously need to look up while you are playing Stardew Valley. Quickly look up what a villager loves getting as a gift, what sales price an artisan good has, whether a shop is open and much more. 

Current available information:

– Every season’s crops, fish and foraging

Sales prices
Growth time
Where and when to find or buy
Who would love/like this as a gift

– Shops

Opening hours
Shop inventory
Upgrade prices 
How to unlock items

– Villagers

Birthday
What do they like/love as gifts
Where are they located in town right now?
Can I marry this villager? 

And many more features are coming!
Don't hesitate to contact us with any feature requests.

This is an unofficial app for Stardew Valley. This app is not affiliated with the Stardew Valley brand.

Plus envie de rouler aujourd'hui... il est temps de trouver un endroit où poser le camping-car pour la nuit. Et franchement, ce soir, aucune envie de faire à manger. Un bon repas servi à la table d’un restaurant ne serait pas de refus.
Pour cela, faut-il encore trouver un établissement où l'on peut parquer facilement et si possible qui ne soit pas trop cher.
Problème...  Après avoir mangé, il faudra reprendre le volant pour trouver un endroit ou passer la nuit. Vraiment pas agréable!
Ce n'est pas ce soir qu'on ira au restaurant.
CAMPER GOURMET VOUS APPORTE LA SOLUTION...

That’s enough driving for today... it's time to find a place to park up the motorhome for the night. And, frankly, nobody’s looking forward to making dinner. Finding a restaurant that can serve up a good meal would be ideal.
That means you need to find a place where you can park easily and, if possible, that isn’t too expensive.
Problem... once you’ve eaten, you'll have to get behind the wheel again to find somewhere to stay overnight. That doesn’t sound fun...
So it looks like you won’t be having dinner at a restaurant after all!
CAMPING GOURMET BRINGS YOU THE SOLUTION...

Keine Lust, heute noch weiter zu fahren... es ist Zeit, einen Platz zu finden, um das Wohnmobil für die Nacht zu parken. Und offen gesagt haben Sie heute Abend auch keine Lust mehr, Abendessen zu kochen. Eine gute Mahlzeit in einem Restaurant wäre jetzt eine feine Sache.
Dazu ist es noch notwendig, eine Lokal zu finden, an dem man einfach parken kann und das nach Möglichkeit nicht zu teuer ist.
Und noch ein Problem... nach dem Essen müssen Sie wieder ans Steuer, um einen Platz für die Übernachtung zu finden. Wirklich nicht angenehm...
Also doch kein Restaurantbesuch heute Abend!
CAMPING-GOURMET BRINGT IHNEN DIE LÖSUNG...

Basta guidare per oggi... è tempo di trovare un posto dove parcheggiare il camper per la notte. E sinceramente, stasera, non hai nessuna voglia di preparare da mangiare. Un buon pasto servito al tavolo di un ristorante non sarebbe male.
Per averlo, bisogna trovare un posto dove si possa parcheggiare facilmente e, se possibile, che non sia troppo costoso.
Ma... dopo aver mangiato, bisognerà rimettersi al volante per trovare un posto dove passare la notte. Che seccatura...
Niente ristorante stasera!
CAMPER GOURMET È LA SOLUZIONE...
